summary: Corrects an omission in the registry of object identifiers assigned by the PKIX working group. RFC 7299 documented identifiers under an IANA-allocated arc, but a small number assigned in RFC 4212 were left out. This document updates RFC 7299 to include them.

plainLanguage.summary: A phone book missed a few names. This note adds them back.

questions: what is the pkix object identifier registry
what does rfc 9158 add to rfc 7299
subtitle: Adds two PKIX object identifiers missing from RFC 7299 and creates a registry for their arc.

tldr.problem: RFC 7299 documented the object identifiers assigned by the PKIX Working Group but left out a small number assigned in RFC 4212.
tldr.mechanism: IANA created a new subregistry for the arc 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.5.1.7 and listed id-acTemplate (1) and id-openPGPCertTemplateExt (2), with Specification Required for future entries.
tldr.outcome: The registry now covers the omitted identifiers. The RFC updates RFC 7299 and raises no new security considerations.

today: RFC 9158 is an Informational RFC from November 2021 that updates RFC 7299. The metadata shows it has not been obsoleted or updated itself.

sections.title: The Omission
sections.content:
An object identifier arc, 1.3.6.1.5.5.7, was allocated by IANA when the Public Key Infrastructure using X.509 (PKIX) Working Group was chartered. After the group closed, RFC 7299 described the identifiers assigned in that arc, but a small number assigned in RFC 4212 were left out.

The PKIX Certificate Management Protocol (RFC 4210) allocated id-regCtrl-altCertTemplate (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.5.1.7), and two identifiers were then assigned within it. This RFC describes them, establishes an IANA registry for the arc and sets allocation policy.
sections.plainLanguage: A list of official labels forgot a couple of entries. This note finds them and writes them in.

sections.title: The New Subregistry
sections.content:
IANA created the "SMI Security for PKIX CRMF Registration Controls for Alternate Certificate Formats" subregistry (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.5.1.7) within the Structure of Management Information (SMI) Numbers registry. It starts with two entries from RFC 4212: decimal 1, id-acTemplate, and decimal 2, id-openPGPCertTemplateExt.

Future additions follow the Specification Required policy of RFC 8126. The expert is to ensure new values are strongly related to PKIX Working Group work, needed for PKIX CMP or CMC to support alternative certificate formats. Identifiers for other purposes should not be assigned in this arc.
sections.plainLanguage: Two missing labels are added. Any new label must be about the same kind of job, and a reviewer checks.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The document populates an IANA registry and raises no new security considerations. The protocols that specify these values include the security considerations associated with their usage.
sections.plainLanguage: Adding names to a list does not create new dangers.
